test_title: PYST 37: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: 'NPQS' is related to 'JLMO' in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, 'JLMO' is related to 'FHIK'. To which of the following is 'PRSU' related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘NPQS is written as JLMO’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d836a01e014f5f1686576b1ba52203fe03bebe54d2a220cef7373295719f171.png] 

For, 'JLMO is written as FHIK',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2633d9644239d792e421f8604bfdbc9ea42d366381e63ac18a16a16873f54692.png] 

Similarly, for 'PRSU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ba5dba49ef2e7568be1a13923dcfaefe4efc2e5e0974ea1dd8620dcd6b7b940.png] 

So, 'PRSU' will be written as 'LNOQ'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
